text.description_html:
First Impressions Spoon Door / Appliance Pulls

Cast in solid brass this original design door pull is a popular choice for refrigerators, freezers and restaurant doors. This 12" high Spoon pull is from the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International, famous for high quality innovational door pull designs.

They are sure to be a hit at your next gathering after you install them on your Sub Zero refrigerator and freezer.

Specifications for First Impressions Spoon Door Pull

  • Pull Height: 12"
  • Pull Thickness: 1/2"
  • Max Width: 2-1/4"
  • Center to Center: 7-3/32"
  • Total Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Material: Solid Brass

Packaged standard with mounting screws for a refrigerator/appliance door panels. For other doors optional Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other).

*Sold Individually
